summary: Entergy Texas, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an ordinary debt offering—$425M of 5.20% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036—pursuant to an existing shelf registration. The underwriting agreement was signed May 11, 2026, and closed May 14, 2026. No premium, price per share, acquisition, or restructuring elements exist; the filing merely documents the issuance terms and exhibits legal opinions. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No activist, tender, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing lacks any event-driven catalyst; thus no risk-arb angle applies.
